beads.title: codex build seat: a build prompt shaped 'bead-id + instruction' is read as a /discover directive - the agent loads the discover skill, returns after ONE turn, and the round ships an empty diff into review
beads.description:
MEASURED 2026-09-13T07:40Z on lunar_station-a7w (session tranquility-srjvmb, the codex build seat under lunar's arming, model gpt-5.6-sol[xhigh]). The round's agent step completed, review ran, and the round gated at review/route with code-validation and declared-tests-present hard blocks and spec-adherence F / test-coverage F - all of which are consequences of ONE fact: the agent produced nothing. Worktree at HEAD == local main, git status clean, zero commits beyond main.

THE AGENT RECORD (telemetry/lunar_station-a7w_agent.usage.json), verbatim head of `result`:
  "I'm using the `discover` skill because this is a directed bead request. I'll load its instructions and bead context, then implement, validate, and commit only within this worktree. The skill confirms the bead is already designed and that directed instructions are authorized. ..."
  num_turns: 1

So the builder read its task prompt - a bead id followed by an instruction - as the discover skill's DIRECTED form ("a bead-id followed by an instruction is directed: same context load, but it carries out the instruction") and, having loaded that skill, ended the turn. One turn, no edits, no commit. Nothing downstream can tell an empty round from a wrong one: declared-tests-present reports the design's test file "missing from pinned diff", code-validation reports the untouched getter, and two critics grade F. A human ruling is spent on what should have been a builder refusal or a retry.

WHAT IS WRONG (refinement decides the fix, not this text): the discover skill's trigger description overlaps the build seat's task-prompt shape, and the build seat does not verify that its agent step produced a non-empty diff before handing the round to review. Two candidate cures, possibly both: (1) scope the discover skill out of the build seat's overlay (it is the grid HOME's front door - a builder in a worktree has no business loading it), or make its trigger text not match a bead-id+instruction task prompt; (2) the agent step treats "zero commits beyond base after the agent returns" as a step failure with the agent's final message as the reason, and retries once or gates with THAT reason - never lets an empty diff reach the committee.

CONTEXT: other codex-built rounds tonight (tg-hnhw, tg-0b64, pow-5zpe) built normally; the difference is prompt shape, not the model. The same round also exposed a second, independent defect - the pinned diff for a lunar_station round is computed against origin/main while lunar_station's local main is 55 commits ahead - filed separately in the_grid; do not conflate them.

CONSTRAINTS AND DECIDED (governor, 2026-09-13T11:2xZ, curing the spec-readiness hold on round 0 - axes 3 and 4; both entries verified present and accepted):
- power_station#the-worktree-overlay-scope-widens-to-every-skill-tree (pow-99g) - a codex build worktree receives the SAME vended skill trees a claude seat gets. This bead does NOT reverse it for one skill: the discover skill stays in the build overlay. The earlier AC-2 'option 1' (make discover not loadable from a build seat) is WITHDRAWN.
- the_grid#a38-first-live-arm-proven-the-oneturn-quarantine-fix-three-f - a oneTurn session's completion is judged by COMMIT PRESENCE, not by turn count or exit signal. AC-1 is that doctrine applied at the build step: compose with the existing commit-presence mechanism a38 names (find it before adding a check; do not build a second one).
DECIDED APPROACH, two edits and nothing else: (1) the build step treats an agent return with zero commits beyond the round's base as a step FAILURE carrying the agent's final message as its reason (flare + gate or one retry), using a38's commit-presence judgement; (2) the discover skill's trigger text (station_overlay claude/skills/discover/SKILL.md lines 8-10 and the agents/skills twin) is narrowed so it keys on a HUMAN invocation of /discover or the human's own words ('let's build', 'I have an idea', 'what should I do with <bead>') and no longer describes a bare 'bead-id followed by an instruction' as directed - that phrase is what a build seat's task prompt matches. The skill's directed form still works when invoked as /discover <bead-id> <instruction>; only the trigger description changes, in both overlay legs, with a parity test.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1 — Fence build completion on a commit after the round base

Paths: `packages/grid_assets/lib/src/code/code_capabilities.dart`, `packages/grid_assets/lib/src/agent/agent_session.dart`, `packages/grid_assets/test/agent/build_completion_test.dart`
Change: Extend the existing `AgentCapability` completion path and the existing `ArtifactFencedSession`; add no circuit node and no second source-control seam. Add the registry's existing `GitRunner` to `AgentCapability`, default it to `SystemGitRunner`, and pass `buildCodeRegistry(gitRunner:)` through. Rename `GitSourceControl._countCommitsAhead` to one shared private range-count helper accepting an exact base ref, retain its adopted-base caller with `refs/remotes/<remote>/<base>`, and use the same helper for `git rev-list --count <Workspace.baseSha>..HEAD`. Declare `CompletionContract.committedWorkspace` so the existing interrupted-dirty-tree fence remains composed. At each argv `result` or channel `createSession` effect edge, synchronously capture the ambient `Workspace`, whether `ServiceBundle.sourceControl` is mounted, the runner, adapter id, node path, and cancel token; never reread tree context after awaiting git. Preserve the established offline behavior only when source control is absent or the workspace directory does not exist. For a live workspace, a blank `Workspace.baseSha`, failed or invalid git count, or count zero must become `CapabilityFailureKind.noResult`; the argv path obtains the harness final message with `readEnvelopeResultText`, and the channel path reuses `ArtifactFencedSession` with optional failure-kind and diagnostic parameters whose defaults preserve current callers, taking the message from `ProcessSessionCompleted.result['text']`. Both paths use `capturedOutputReason` so the bounded failure reason contains the harness message, and both check `StepArgs.cancel` after the git await. A positive count returns the existing usage/result map byte-for-byte. Override `AgentCapability.supervisionPolicy` for `noResult` with `RetryPolicy(maxRestarts: 2, backoff: Backoff.standard, onExhaustion: ExhaustionBehavior.parkAtGate)`, which gives one initial ride plus one retry; because `review` already depends on `agent`, neither failure is a positive terminal and the second reason parks visibly. Add fake-runner and fake-session probes for zero, unreadable, missing-base, and positive counts; argv/channel reason parity; unchanged successful payloads; the one-retry gate policy; and the unchanged `review.dependsOn == {'agent'}` topology.
Test: `cd packages/grid_assets && dart test test/agent/build_completion_test.dart`
Expect: `All tests passed!`

### Step 2 — Narrow discover's advertised trigger to human invocation

Make the identical descriptions say that triggering requires a HUMAN's explicit `/discover` invocation — including `/discover <bead-id> <instruction>` — or the human's own discovery phrases such as “let's build”, “I have an idea”, “plan this”, “design this”, “what's the state of <bead>”, “what should I do with <bead>”, and “have we already decided this”. Do not advertise a plain bead-id-plus-instruction prompt as directed. Leave the skill body's Dispatch rules unchanged, so the directed form still executes after explicit `/discover`, and leave the generated overlay manifest unchanged so `discover` remains vended. In `overlay_codex_leg_test.dart`, parse each skill's YAML frontmatter, compare only the two `description` values rather than whole skill files, assert `vendedSkillIds` and the manifest still include `discover`, assert the former trigger sentence is absent, and exercise a small test-only trigger predicate showing `pow-p8il Implement the accepted spec` is false while `/discover pow-p8il Implement the accepted spec` and the named human phrases are true.
Test: `cd packages/grid_assets && dart test test/assets/overlay_codex_leg_test.dart test/assets/skill_assets_test.dart`

## Validation Plan

beads.title: the vended agent definitions are ~4,400 tokens each, duplicate what verbs answer, and hide at least one wrong instruction
beads.description:
WHY: obligation 3 of
memento-engineering#a-station-explains-itself-through-prime-and-bounded-help
(merged 2026-09-12) - instruction files shrink to what no verb can answer, and
anything a verb can answer is DELETED from prose rather than duplicated into it.

MEASURED 2026-09-12, the vended agent definitions in this package:
  extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/governor.md  12,022 bytes  ~4,452 tokens
  extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/refiner.md   11,933 bytes  ~4,419 tokens
A seat loads one of these at session open and carries it on every turn
thereafter. It is the largest single instruction surface a seat pays for, larger
than CLAUDE.md, and it is pushed rather than pulled.

TWO DEFECTS, not one:

1. IT DUPLICATES WHAT VERBS ANSWER. The definitions restate tool grammar, verb
   flags and store rules that the verbs themselves can report. Under the ratified
   entry that content is deleted, not shortened - the verb is the source, and a
   second copy drifts the moment the verb changes.

2. AT LEAST ONE INSTRUCTION IN THEM IS WRONG, and its wrongness is measured.
   The refiner definition instructs a seat to write a receipt note onto
   ANOTHER seat's disc. On 2026-09-12 a refiner did exactly that at 00:58; the
   governor's own index rewrite erased the pointer line at 06:24, and the file
   has never been read. pow-h72x carries that correction specifically. It is
   cited here as evidence that a large pushed prose surface hides wrong
   instructions well - nobody audits 4,400 tokens they did not write.

WHAT THESE FILES SHOULD KEEP: the seat's mandate, the human gates, the safety
invariants, and the judgement that no command can encode. That is what a role
definition is FOR.

WHAT THEY SHOULD LOSE: verb grammar, flag lists, store mechanics, and any
procedure that a circuit runs. Each of those has an owner that cannot drift.

SEQUENCING: pow-5zpe makes prime name the station's verbs, which is what makes
deleting verb grammar from these files safe. Land that first or this change
removes a pointer before its replacement exists. Not wired as a hard blocker,
because the wrong-instruction half (defect 2) is worth doing regardless, but the
deletion half should follow prime.

NOT IN SCOPE: the skills under the same overlay, and any station's own CLAUDE.md.
Those are separate surfaces with separate owners; name them as successors.
beads.design:
## Implementation Plan

### Step 1 — Reduce both pushed role definitions to role-owned policy

Paths: `packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/governor.md`, `packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/refiner.md`
Change: keep each YAML frontmatter block byte-for-byte, keep each current `## Cost — a request costs what the context costs` section byte-for-byte, and rewrite the remaining body so both files expose exactly this ordered heading list: `## The mandate`, `## The operating loop`, `## Cost — a request costs what the context costs`, `## Human gates — never cross without an explicit, per-item go`, `## Safety invariants (non-negotiable)`. Delete the complete `## Tool grammar` and `## The skills` sections rather than moving their content. Delete every exact station invocation, option/flag recipe, store-query recipe, and command-output literal outside a safety prohibition; in particular neither definition may retain `{{runner}}`, `bd -C`, `bd batch`, `bd export`, `--state-root`, or `gh pr edit`. The operating-loop sections remain only as short human-seat judgement, never a restatement of a station circuit or command contract.

For `governor.md`, retain the role boundary that the governor operates the resident station and files engine or asset defects instead of engineering them. Retain the full throughput policy: no date-based pending queue; a driveable ready P0/P1 is driven when the board is idle; an ADR departure is recorded rather than used to idle the station; and `ready > 0` with `mounted 0` is an incident. Its policy-level loop has six numbered items named `Sweep`, `Diagnose`, `Intervene`, `Record`, `Watch`, and `Report`. The `Sweep` item must say exactly: “For a stamped-but-unmounted bead, enumerate every open blocker across in-store and cross-store dependencies before calling it a human gate. Closed blockers do not count. A release node or a blocker whose notes say an agent executes it is GOVERNOR WORK; name its id, owning store, and next executable action.” Preserve all five existing governor gate categories and their qualifications: merge policy including the `merge=human` override, first live arm, persistence or credentials, human-owned release promotion while agents may publish prereleases on an already-authorized rung, and any wider outward or irreversible act. Preserve all current governor safety categories: scoped coexistence, bd-only writes and the no-polling-`bd show` guard, lifecycle-store ownership, and fail-closed effect verification. Add the exact ownership rule “Your Agent Disc is your own. A finding another seat must act on belongs on the relevant bead. Never write that seat's Agent Disc.”

For `refiner.md`, retain the role boundary that the human is present, the refiner makes filed beads approvable and the backlog true, interviews one decision at a time with deciding context, records each ruling in the same turn, and never operates the live station. Replace the detailed filing checklist and filing invocation with the policy pointer “The station's filing verdict is the completeness oracle; follow its failing details and mint no competing completeness predicate.” Its policy-level loop has seven numbered items named `Resume`, `Interview`, `Verify`, `Shape`, `Reconcile`, `Stage or approve`, and `Hand off`, each limited to the named human-facing responsibility and free of command grammar. Preserve all five existing refiner gate categories and their qualifications: explicit per-bead human approval and never un-stamping, undecided either/or forks, no merge or push to main and no live-arm/persistence/credential action, human-owned release promotion while prerelease publication on an already-authorized rung remains agent work, and no closing or re-homing human-owned work without a receipt. Preserve all current refiner safety categories: truthful refiner actor identity, bd-only writes, lifecycle-store ownership, coexistence, the read-only refinement-subagent ceiling with no hand-rolled judge circuit, and fail-closed reliance on the filing verdict. Replace every affirmative governor-disc receipt sentence with the exact ownership rule “Your handoffs, lessons and observations go on your Agent Disc. A finding another seat must act on belongs on the relevant bead. Never write that seat's Agent Disc.” Neither role definition may name a `kind: receipt` note on the governor disc.

Do not change either vended handoff or operational skill, any Agents-leg skill, any station-owned `CLAUDE.md`, the manifest, or the materializer. Those pre-existing prose owners remain successor surfaces to audit separately; this change creates no replacement prose file.
Test: `! rg -n '\{\{runner\}\}|^## (Tool grammar|The skills)$|bd -C|bd batch|bd export|--state-root|gh pr edit|kind: receipt.*governor' packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/governor.md packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/refiner.md && test "$(wc -c < packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/governor.md | tr -d ' ')" -lt 12916 && test "$(wc -c < packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/refiner.md | tr -d ' ')" -lt 11945`
Expect: exits 0 with no forbidden prose matches and both byte counts below the live baseline
Commit: `docs(agents): reduce role definitions to policy`

### Step 2 — Make the reduced role contract and measurement durable

Paths: `packages/grid_assets/test/assets/skill_assets_test.dart`, `packages/grid_assets/test/assets/governor_work_sweep_test.dart`, `packages/grid_assets/test/assets/handoff_skill_test.dart`
Change: extend the existing asset tests rather than adding a second overlay-test subsystem. In `skill_assets_test.dart`, retain the packaging, frontmatter, manifest, provenance, and retired-label/defer fences; remove assertions that require the deleted command grammar, detailed filing checklist, skill catalog, cross-seat governor receipt, and old seven-section shape. Add six exactly named tests: `mandates, human gates, and safety invariants remain load-bearing` checks every role-specific clause enumerated in Step 1 plus the unchanged governor cost-posture markers; `each role says what it must never do` checks the explicit engineering/operation, human-gate, coexistence, writer, store, judge-circuit, and Agent-Disc prohibitions; `cross-seat findings never write another seat disc` requires the exact bead/Agent-Disc ownership sentence in both definitions and rejects the former affirmative phrases `because that is the disc its occupant reads`, `hand the governor a receipt on its disc`, and `leave the governor its receipts`; `verb grammar and circuit-owned procedure are absent` rejects the deleted headings and every forbidden syntax marker named in Step 1; `role definitions share one section structure` compares each file's line-start `## ` headings against one canonical constant containing the five headings from Step 1; and `both definitions shrink below the live baseline` reads through the existing source-located package root, compares UTF-8 byte counts against 12,916 and 11,945, computes estimated tokens as `(body.runes.length / 2.69).round()`, and compares them against 4,758 and 4,406.

In `governor_work_sweep_test.dart`, keep the detailed command-bearing `_sweepSentences` assertions solely on the unchanged `station-operations` skill, and replace the current two-source equality with a separate assertion that the governor definition's `1. **Sweep**` through `2. **Diagnose**` body carries the exact three-sentence policy from Step 1. This preserves the governor-work judgement while making the skill the sole owner of its procedure. In `handoff_skill_test.dart`, delete only the final group that requires the governor definition to repeat the handoff skill's start/end ritual and skill-menu placement; retain every test of both vended handoff skill legs and installation.

After the file tests pass, append exactly one measurement receipt to `pow-wtyb` without replacing existing notes. Set `base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)`; obtain each before body with `git show "$base:<path>"`, each after body from the worktree, count UTF-8 bytes with `wc -c`, count Unicode characters with `wc -m`, and compute each approximate token count with `awk` as the rounded character count divided by 2.69. Refuse to write the receipt unless the before counts are governor 12,916 bytes / approximately 4,758 tokens and refiner 11,945 bytes / approximately 4,406 tokens and both after pairs are strictly smaller. Then run `BD_JSON_ENVELOPE=1 bd update pow-wtyb --actor build --append-notes "Agent-definition measurement at base $base: estimator=round(Unicode characters / 2.69); governor 12916 bytes / ~4758 tokens -> $governor_after_bytes bytes / ~$governor_after_tokens tokens; refiner 11945 bytes / ~4406 tokens -> $refiner_after_bytes bytes / ~$refiner_after_tokens tokens."`. This bead note is the measurement record; do not put it into an overlay prose file.
Test: `cd packages/grid_assets && dart test test/assets/skill_assets_test.dart test/assets/governor_posture_test.dart test/assets/governor_work_sweep_test.dart test/assets/handoff_skill_test.dart`
Expect: `All tests passed!`
Commit: `test(agents): fence the reduced role contract`

## Touches
- `packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/governor.md` — modified; `The Governor`
- `packages/grid_assets/extension/station_overlay/claude/agents/refiner.md` — modified; `The Refiner`
- `packages/grid_assets/test/assets/skill_assets_test.dart` — modified; `mandates, human gates, and safety invariants remain load-bearing`, `each role says what it must never do`, `cross-seat findings never write another seat disc`, `verb grammar and circuit-owned procedure are absent`, `role definitions share one section structure`, `both definitions shrink below the live baseline`

Re-validated against the live tree: HEAD 9070c01 is clean; pow-5zpe is closed and its composed-runner prime orientation is present; pow-h72x remains open but its role-only correction and pow-tpsl polarity fence are subsumed here without touching either handoff skill; dependent pow-07zx already blocks on pow-wtyb and can add its pull-request ownership policy to the retained governor `1. **Sweep**` seam; every current role-definition caller/test is covered by the five Touches records; all six new test names are announced here and do not yet exist.

## ADR Alignment
- `memento-engineering#a-station-explains-itself-through-prime-and-bounded-help` — applied: “Instruction files shrink to what no verb can answer — policy, human rulings, and the constraints with no command behind them. - `power_station#the-governor-carries-a-cost-posture-ranked-under-throughput` — applied: “The vended governor carries a `## Cost` section, and it is RANKED UNDER the mandate's throughput rules.” That section remains byte-for-byte and its dedicated test remains in the gate.

beads.title: grid_assets: the relay seat asset — a cheap-model brief and read-only tool set that inspects a stuck session and returns absorb-with-horizon or escalate; absorb by default, failure escalates
beads.description: Child 4 of the relay-seat epic (the_grid tg-pwpy). The relay's persona and tools as a grid asset: the brief states the protective-relay mission (sense the abnormal condition, decide whether desired state must change, never act as the breaker), the refuse-by-default posture (ABSORB unless escalation is justified) and the failure rule (cannot answer → escalate). Tools: read the session's worktree mtimes and last commit, its flare tail, its telemetry usage records and any open gate; write only the verdict. Output is the grid_engine verdict type (absorb + horizon, or escalate + reason). Tests feed recorded session snapshots (a healthy long build, a paused session with a two-day-old worktree, a gated session awaiting a human, an erroring lane) and assert the verdicts. Pointers: lib/src/agent/seat_environments.dart (RelayAgentEnvironment, child 1), the critic seat assets as the pattern for a read-only inspecting seat, the governor disc lesson detect-and-recover-a-dead-session (worktree mtimes are the signal).
